title: Horizon and Archive
author: Ansel Fairweather
blurb: Ines Lockridge, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
